name: theia greenaway
description: seraphim blush is the work of yorkshire-based musician theia greenaway. she uses a slew of interwoven computer programs, phone recordings and trinkets to gather a collage of aural sentimentalities, reconfigured into ecstatic texture environments and nonverbal meltdown melodies. last year she released her inaugural release 'rot fungus animorph' - a five track e.p. of computer-reconfigured sample collages, stitched together from phone recordings, trinkets and improvisations both at home and at live shows between 2023-2024 - available now on digital and cassette via bandcamp.
